neighbours.label: the slot before the destination when a motor signal or a mechanical force is passed along a path (to the muscles, to the rear axle), as opposed to people, goods or papers moved along a path in the same setting
fire: Motor nerves pass the impulse from the spinal cord to the calf muscles.
The corticospinal tract carries movement commands down to the muscles of the hand.
The ulnar nerve sends signals from the neck to the small muscles of the hand.
A tie rod conveys the steering load from the rack to the front wheels.
The crankshaft passes the energy of the pistons to the flywheel.
A short chain sends the power from the motor to the rear axle.
The gears transmit the torque from the engine to the drive wheels.
Hydraulic lines carry the pressure from the master cylinder to the calipers.
quiet: A pneumatic tube carries the samples from the spinal ward to the muscle clinic.
The neurologist sent her notes down to the doctors of the hand unit.
The porter took the samples from the neck clinic to the small lab of the hospital.
A conveyor belt carries the crates from the press to the rear garage.
The mechanic passed the box of pistons to the apprentice.
A short path leads from the motor shed to the rear yard.
The dealer shipped the engine from the factory to the drive-in.
Delivery trucks carry the cylinders from the warehouse to the garage.

short: slot before where a motor signal or force goes
notes: Round 2. An earlier round's label also claimed that inbound paths stay quiet, and it failed on two inbound nerve items. Sensory paths are not claimed now: they are uneven ('from the hand to the' 0.68, 'from the diaphragm to the' 0.59, 'from the eye to the' 0.08, 'from the gut to the' 0.03). Probes: 'commands to the' 0.78, 'relay the order to the' 0.69, 'transfers the force to the' 0.55, 'sends the power to the' 0.60, 'passes the motion to the' 0.27; 'sends letters to the', 'ships furniture to the', 'brought the children to the', 'passed the ball to the', 'road leads ... to the' 0.02 or less. Card also has network code (units=10 in a logits layer; 'output layer' 1.02, input layer 0.06), which this label does not test. Other flows also fired in probes ('Blood flows from the heart to the' 0.44, 'released by the gland into the' 0.33, 'current flows through the wire to the' 0.24) and may belong to the same pattern; they are not claimed either.
